description: Structural authoring hints, not an exhaustive runtime validator. Asset paths, identities, reflected properties and event compatibility must be validated in game.
title: RuneSchema /blueprints

x-runeschema-runtime-widget.description: Event-driven live widget property edits and optional multicast delegate binding.
x-runeschema-runtime-widget.owner: Existing loaded widget Blueprint class name or /Game/ generated-class path.
x-runeschema-runtime-widget.widgetPath: Dot-separated reflected object-property path from the live owner widget.

bind.Event: Reflected multicast delegate property on the target widget.
bind.Target: Optional dot-separated path from the owner; omit or use $Owner for the owner.
bind.Function: Reflected function on the selected target with a compatible delegate signature.
